ledger: Gold coin on green felt, right of center cup (00:00-00:02.75): engraved single-line pseudo-word; sharpest at 00:00 reads roughly 'Ŧrevso'/'Tresno' with a small mark above; at 00:02 reads roughly 'Bwrɯ'-like with mark above; at 00:03.25 a short smeared word. Not a real word in any frame.

Silver coin on felt, lower right (00:00-00:02.75): engraved single-line pseudo-word, sharpest at 00:02 reads roughly 'PREYWY'/'PRYWY' in blocky caps ringed by dots; at 00:03.25 (same coin, camera moved) the legend shows as two stacked lines of smeared glyphs ('ЖЖЖЖ' over 'ΣΥΣΥ'-like) rather than one word.
Gold coin, bottom left of felt (enters at 00:03.0-00:04.5): smeared one-line pseudo-word, not resolvable.
Coin stack in center cup (00:00-00:02.75): large decorative emblem/glyph cluster resembling a monogram, not a script; stays consistent within the close-up shots.
Chips/medallions around the red border (whole clip): illustrated emblems, stars, figures; tiny marks too small/out of focus to read; no legible words.
Wide shots 00:04.5-00:09.75: all coin/chip markings too small, blurred and oblique to read; no signage, screens or plates legible in background; framed picture on wall contains no text.

findings.entity: Engraved legends on the loose gold and silver coins on the green felt
findings.description: The coins in sharp foreground focus carry engraved legends rendered as glyph-like pseudo-words ('Tresno'/'Bwrɯ', 'PREYWY') that are not coherent words or denominations in any recognizable language; with clear coin design (dot ring, centred legend) a viewer would expect real lettering.

findings.entity: Silver coin lower right of felt
findings.description: Between 00:02 (single blocky line 'PREYWY') and 00:03.25 (same untouched coin, same position relative to the cups) the legend appears as two stacked lines of different glyphs; nobody touches the coin, so the inscription change is unexplained. The camera reframes and the text is small, which lowers confidence.
